thread:
Aisha (People Ops): Hi all 1 1 Following up from today's all-hands: putting a short live thread for operational Qs on hybrid/hub booking, offsite approvals, and travel safety. Keep replies short and we'll capture answers.

Raj (Eng): If I rotate team members through the NY hub for a week sprint, do we need a formal offsite request or is hub booking enough?

Aisha (People Ops): For team sprints >3 days where we bill as an "offsite" (venue/food budget), submit the Offsite Request. For ad-hoc desk bookings <3 days just use the hub calendar. Link: https://intranet.redwood/offsites

Maya (Recruiting): Interview candidates: can we book interview rooms at hubs? Any guest badge rules?

Carl (Facilities): Yes, interview rooms are bookable. For candidates, schedule a visitor pass at least 24h ahead. If candidate is from a staffing agency, we need vendor confirmation. Use the Visitor Request form on the Facilities page.

Raj (Eng): Good call. Also is there a recommended meeting room size for all-hands with 30 people? Some hubs only show small rooms.

Carl (Facilities): Book a small event space or "Team Suite" via the booking portal. If you need AV, add "AV support" and allow 48h for setup. For capacity >20, route the request to facilities@redwood for confirmation.

Priya (PM): Offsite safety question: what COVID/illness guidance are we using for multi-day events? Do we require testing or refunds?

Aisha (People Ops): Current guidance: symptomatic people should stay home and use sick leave. For company-funded multi-day offsites, we fund a single rapid test per person if needed and will accept cancellations up to 72h for health reasons with full refund of company-covered costs. We'll add this to the offsite playbook.

Devon (Finance): Budget clarity: if an offsite includes outside contractors, can we code them to the same cost center? Any special processing?

Aisha (People Ops): Contractors should be invoiced via the vendor's team. If the contractor costs are paid directly by Redwood (rare), Finance needs vendor docs + PO. Otherwise include contractor estimates in the Offsite Request so Finance can allocate.

Raj (Eng): Travel bookings: managers prefer to buy economy + seat selection. Any rule about business class?

Devon (Finance): Domestic flights: economy. Long-haul >8 hours: manager+Finance approval for premium economy or business on a case-by-case basis. Add justification in the Offsite Request.

Facilities-Bot: Desk booking reminder: "You can reserve desks up to 60 days in advance. Cancel within 24 hours to release space."

Maya (Recruiting): For candidate travel we reimburse up to $300 for domestic interviews, right? Confirm before booking?

Devon (Finance): Correct: standard candidate travel cap $300 domestic. If higher, request pre-approval from Recruiting + Finance. Keep receipts.

Legal: Quick note: for offsites with recordings or content capture (photos, video), add a consent line on the registration and notify attendees. We can provide a sample consent blurb.

Priya (PM): Great — can we add a template offsite agenda and consent text to the Offsite Request form? Saves time.

Aisha (People Ops): Yes, doing that. Will add: budget template, agenda template, and consent snippet.

Raj (Eng): Badge expiry: my badge expires next month due to role change. How do I renew for hub access?

Carl (Facilities): Ask your manager to submit an Access Change request. Temporary renewals (<=30 days) can be handled by Facilities with manager approval.

Maya (Recruiting): One more: childcare/stipend while traveling for offsite? Some teams asked at the all-hands.

Aisha (People Ops): We have a limited childcare travel stipend for primary caregivers attending mandatory company events. It's case-by-case and needs People Ops pre-approval. Use "Special Expense" on the Offsite Request and attach receipt after.

Raj (Eng): Thanks 1 any ETA on handbook update?

Aisha (People Ops): We'll push an update to the Workstyle & Offsite sections by end of week and ping #people-ops with highlights.

HR-Bot: Reminder: update your primary work location in People Portal if you're switching hubs this quarter.

Aisha (People Ops): OK closing for now. If you need letters for visas, vendor agreements, or large-budget exceptions DM me. I'll compile these notes into the handbook and pin the Offsite Request and templates in this channel. :thumbsup:
